objective: SHANNON's Sahara Guardian (ForgeGUI site model 'Sahara Guardian Rare Variant', artifact 30d3ddb4) brought into Animal Stations as SHANNON asked (2026-11-24: 'take that model from forge and animate it into roblox and give it an insane power attack'): the one mesh with its sun halo skinned to the Stations rig, uploaded, given the lions' idle and attack and a power attack of its own, Sun's Judgement.
